On average, the liver clears alcohol at a steady rate of about **0.015% blood alcohol concentration (BAC) per hour** (roughly one standard drink per hour), and nothing can speed up that baseline rate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhZ1D2hbFTtIkHsWFSDMBhqWPILYZ76FW9vBIvRzB9pBUNgNmHzUS0VptpLM0VEgGnLq3oUM_7fKu8AsgQwdffssnjKhV53kd8Vq9j9M02-TFF1Dpa-d2DCfvIgTOz4XLHHkgMRCn3BN3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xIboFBJx3F_mBm32IZkO58IjR1BgMBhty2EYtqI_C6zXRngaTin1hkc9BAUIDRysp_2xf1o4ojjuZBDFcoV-n8a967zHPPVQCultb8S92qGC61qedV6pigXHVTmlz7Bagb0tHHSepwkgS8f4PVAEaX9cSyhEGSobBw-1cxgNNtO-9mrlyeY-OggKecMoVWgvtqWHZczlMMh)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX4UukPf0s40l7JE8BbPXEY5qu0mIp4sOLaGPuOY0VGw39-WBDYzls2PTLItTRIDivOroHMecdGHAMJgpdmCixzp-AV_fjJPJCrFN_vSm7XabzilBtZesYKpC11kX2RaovNs-t8Et1k8KlU2gXgrH1KQhILIKM)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Oslu11jnmM&t=3)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF10-UnJzIp2Wqfvac9_Eu7NUNXlRjV4WuRotr2uCWDuljmzkNCjqasHB0O6m6Z7cdEigYNlR8hSjG7woDmeHzZTmkMt46xsCH_eeVOEu5CLkRVVEu4E78Zyvf9FhETmUohNpHI3FVMOVCiHRZyQDWTUXxepae4isOHiUVSyNjd7Iz-siLNM29dyhkCTea9RaGn39w)

### Common Causes of Slower Alcohol Processing

- **Liver conditions:** Advanced liver disease or reduced liver function slows down how quickly the liver clears alcohol.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xIboFBJx3F_mBm32IZkO58IjR1BgMBhty2EYtqI_C6zXRngaTin1hkc9BAUIDRysp_2xf1o4ojjuZBDFcoV-n8a967zHPPVQCultb8S92qGC61qedV6pigXHVTmlz7Bagb0tHHSepwkgS8f4PVAEaX9cSyhEGSobBw-1cxgNNtO-9mrlyeY-OggKecMoVWgvtqWHZczlMMh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhZ1D2hbFTtIkHsWFSDMBhqWPILYZ76FW9vBIvRzB9pBUNgNmHzUS0VptpLM0VEgGnLq3oUM_7fKu8AsgQwdffssnjKhV53kd8Vq9j9M02-TFF1Dpa-d2DCfvIgTOz4XLHHkgMRCn3BN3)
- **Medications and other substances:** Drugs that inhibit or compete for liver enzymes—such as acetaminophen (Tylenol), disulfiram (Antabuse), or certain other compounds—can slow alcohol breakdown and raise toxicity risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhZ1D2hbFTtIkHsWFSDMBhqWPILYZ76FW9vBIvRzB9pBUNgNmHzUS0VptpLM0VEgGnLq3oUM_7fKu8AsgQwdffssnjKhV53kd8Vq9j9M02-TFF1Dpa-d2DCfvIgTOz4XLHHkgMRCn3BN3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xIboFBJx3F_mBm32IZkO58IjR1BgMBhty2EYtqI_C6zXRngaTin1hkc9BAUIDRysp_2xf1o4ojjuZBDFcoV-n8a967zHPPVQCultb8S92qGC61qedV6pigXHVTmlz7Bagb0tHHSepwkgS8f4PVAEaX9cSyhEGSobBw-1cxgNNtO-9mrlyeY-OggKecMoVWgvtqWHZczlMMh)
- **Age:** Getting older brings lower liver enzyme efficiency, less muscle mass, and less body water, making alcohol stay in the system longer and hit harder.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1014bYX_7R3l0NFY9n5PhQumVYs_1EHy1LQbYSuoo8P1yZisxbaaABzl2pW3aZrnsyx86c8LygTUi0I89Ba27Kfqn9cZvbDGmoD12JKOB_HN2UpA5LD4CWAfrBXklRwn6ijdVqPvCWeD9fMqpR2AKK5zhz7pC7TVw-wBCe670ZcNYPgU)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX4UukPf0s40l7JE8BbPXEY5qu0mIp4sOLaGPuOY0VGw39-WBDYzls2PTLItTRIDivOroHMecdGHAMJgpdmCixzp-AV_fjJPJCrFN_vSm7XabzilBtZesYKpC11kX2RaovNs-t8Et1k8KlU2gXgrH1KQhILIKM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF12WP9kuhD2nKSok2eFpWDbuD9nXiS7NHDZNfBrUNRWZCNvGyQeOghf7JGSg2GEs8uIsa0IZVs_kEqbkTW9to8mHhXMQtXVoQq87bpmT2csSKYwYVQ2dpHjopJx9sBgwJ8dBzcNoF5EP7ficdgtfmhf7yprViy_Ko2Cnb7JlegY7YPQoNIlA2b82UDj44)
- **Sex and body composition:** Differences in body water, muscle mass, and stomach/liver ADH activity often cause higher peak BAC and longer-lasting effects in females than in males after the same amount.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12yUKOvqTDl8HX2Obmxujwhu1jFtuNc8E001hqWVMYetMToDFvqg2th05MHiGos1T2_IKtqMOokck6AAtmsqau8kAcfxyzOl-3K8HoqxvZ7zpUXqgTvExmgWpi8IHvqE2Rka2lIpsRNFWPoS-rfoeBMyP5sIBlPwbbON15Sy-Y-ZdR01)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Oslu11jnmM&t=3)

### What Actually Helps vs. Myths

- **Time is the only fix:** Coffee, cold showers, naps, or greasy foods do not speed up alcohol elimination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wtXQe_TLoASAbEZHRk5sQOwHMAt131aIWXCVX5s85H8PfieOAsOnBTPh8om-k1AZr4knxBVdR79gjeAhV6yh2cUnQ4THo8UvJeFz4IuXxlKMU8vueJL1_gckA7zlD6L4OHwFxCUwi1QcUwDRUaC18CHYsHHNzZgY-uK_oqbmcpVJnR6UQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF1xIboFBJx3F_mBm32IZkO58IjR1BgMBhty2EYtqI_C6zXRngaTin1hkc9BAUIDRysp_2xf1o4ojjuZBDFcoV-n8a967zHPPVQCultb8S92qGC61qedV6pigXHVTmlz7Bagb0tHHSepwkgS8f4PVAEaX9cSyhEGSobBw-1cxgNNtO-9mrlyeY-OggKecMoVWgvtqWHZczlMMh)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXX4UukPf0s40l7JE8BbPXEY5qu0mIp4sOLaGPuOY0VGw39-WBDYzls2PTLItTRIDivOroHMecdGHAMJgpdmCixzp-AV_fjJPJCrFN_vSm7XabzilBtZesYKpC11kX2RaovNs-t8Et1k8KlU2gXgrH1KQhILIKM)
- **Supportive steps:** Drinking water or low-sugar electrolytes, eating whole foods, and resting help your body recover while waiting for alcohol to clear.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wtXQe_TLoASAbEZHRk5sQOwHMAt131aIWXCVX5s85H8PfieOAsOnBTPh8om-k1AZr4knxBVdR79gjeAhV6yh2cUnQ4THo8UvJeFz4IuXxlKMU8vueJL1_gckA7zlD6L4OHwFxCUwi1QcUwDRUaC18CHYsHHNzZgY-uK_oqbmcpVJnR6UQ)
- **Eating before or while drinking:** Food slows stomach absorption and lowers peak BAC, though it does not speed up liver clearance once alcohol is in the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF10-UnJzIp2Wqfvac9_Eu7NUNXlRjV4WuRotr2uCWDuljmzkNCjqasHB0O6m6Z7cdEigYNlR8hSjG7woDmeHzZTmkMt46xsCH_eeVOEu5CLkRVVEu4E78Zyvf9FhETmUohNpHI3FVMOVCiHRZyQDWTUXxepae4isOHiUVSyNjd7Iz-siLNM29dyhkCTea9RaGn39w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12yUKOvqTDl8HX2Obmxujwhu1jFtuNc8E001hqWVMYetMToDFvqg2th05MHiGos1T2_IKtqMOokck6AAtmsqau8kAcfxyzOl-3K8HoqxvZ7zpUXqgTvExmgWpi8IHvqE2Rka2lIpsRNFWPoS-rfoeBMyP5sIBlPwbbON15Sy-Y-ZdR01)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Oslu11jnmM&t=3)

For more detail on how the body breaks down ethanol, see the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXCbjF38g8adZYiXEfr0_FgdDie6mI1m9oXZXCT_zQveb4KFIWYaQNmq1ozhmjdA0UiQPOARMUSv4XxsfIX8AOcrfqHLyfNdREhBbsLxASKjXCTTK7zedc7oKNzyWcf0o-MgzhhpJqN-JKhSNQVN78MWw) or this scientific review on [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhZ1D2hbFTtIkHsWFSDMBhqWPILYZ76FW9vBIvRzB9pBUNgNmHzUS0VptpLM0VEgGnLq3oUM_7fKu8AsgQwdffssnjKhV53kd8Vq9j9M02-TFF1Dpa-d2DCfvIgTOz4XLHHkgMRCn3BN3) . You can also read about broader metabolic effects on [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wtXQe_TLoASAbEZHRk5sQOwHMAt131aIWXCVX5s85H8PfieOAsOnBTPh8om-k1AZr4knxBVdR79gjeAhV6yh2cUnQ4THo8UvJeFz4IuXxlKMU8vueJL1_gckA7zlD6L4OHwFxCUwi1QcUwDRUaC18CHYsHHNzZgY-uK_oqbmcpVJnR6UQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXhZ1D2hbFTtIkHsWFSDMBhqWPILYZ76FW9vBIvRzB9pBUNgNmHzUS0VptpLM0VEgGnLq3oUM_7fKu8AsgQwdffssnjKhV53kd8Vq9j9M02-TFF1Dpa-d2DCfvIgTOz4XLHHkgMRCn3BN3)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXCbjF38g8adZYiXEfr0_FgdDie6mI1m9oXZXCT_zQveb4KFIWYaQNmq1ozhmjdA0UiQPOARMUSv4XxsfIX8AOcrfqHLyfNdREhBbsLxASKjXCTTK7zedc7oKNzyWcf0o-MgzhhpJqN-JKhSNQVN78MWw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1wtXQe_TLoASAbEZHRk5sQOwHMAt131aIWXCVX5s85H8PfieOAsOnBTPh8om-k1AZr4knxBVdR79gjeAhV6yh2cUnQ4THo8UvJeFz4IuXxlKMU8vueJL1_gckA7zlD6L4OHwFxCUwi1QcUwDRUaC18CHYsHHNzZgY-uK_oqbmcpVJnR6UQ)Are you looking into this for a specific reason, such as **stronger or longer-lasting effects** from drinking, **medication interactions** , or **liver health** ? - **Eating before or while drinking:** Food slows stomach absorption and lowers peak BAC, though it does not speed up liver clearance once alcohol is in the bloodstream.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlwEBxCJF10-UnJzIp2Wqfvac9_Eu7NUNXlRjV4WuRotr2uCWDuljmzkNCjqasHB0O6m6Z7cdEigYNlR8hSjG7woDmeHzZTmkMt46xsCH_eeVOEu5CLkRVVEu4E78Zyvf9FhETmUohNpHI3FVMOVCiHRZyQDWTUXxepae4isOHiUVSyNjd7Iz-siLNM29dyhkCTea9RaGn39w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF12yUKOvqTDl8HX2Obmxujwhu1jFtuNc8E001hqWVMYetMToDFvqg2th05MHiGos1T2_IKtqMOokck6AAtmsqau8kAcfxyzOl-3K8HoqxvZ7zpUXqgTvExmgWpi8IHvqE2Rka2lIpsRNFWPoS-rfoeBMyP5sIBlPwbbON15Sy-Y-ZdR01)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Oslu11jnmM&t=3)
